en: A vintage-style postcard with a monochrome illustration of a large industrial complex, including several factory buildings, smokestacks, and tree-lined avenues. The central focus is on the name 'Gebrs. Dobbelmann,' and there is an anchor logo with the words 'SAVON POSTAL.' The text is primarily in French, with a mention of 'Nimègue (Hollande)' and 'Sept. Médailles.' The design is ornate, with decorative corners and stylized font.
